project_info.theme: Sportswear store update new arrival display
project_info.color_palette: White, black, taupe, blue, gold, neutral gray

main_subject.detail: A wide in-store sportswear display with freestanding racks, a central table, football-themed props, and a vertical athlete poster, presented as a clean retail update announcement.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic store merchandising showcase, retail floor update visual, clean new-arrival announcement

items: Foreground Center: a black display table with folded garments, takeaway cups, a football, and a gold trophy.
Left Rack: white polo and black shorts set hanging prominently, with additional apparel behind.
Right Rack: sleeveless taupe set in front with darker items behind.
Back Center: a vertical athlete poster with BADASS branding and sportswear messaging.
Top Center: a small blue sign clipped above the display.
Below Title: rounded white capsule with black outline reading 'NEW ARRIVAL'.
Background: bright clean retail interior with pale floor and soft neutral store lighting.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Even retail illumination, clear product visibility, neutral polished atmosphere, documentary merchandising realism

assets.name: sportswear store display setup
assets.usage: Use to preserve exact rack positions, table props, and central athlete-poster composition.

assets.name: sportswear assortment and props
assets.usage: Keep the apparel sets, football props, trophy, cups, and folded garments close to the original layout.

assets.name: STORE UPDATE / NEW ARRIVAL typography
assets.usage: Preserve the exact wording and bottom-centered title treatment.

prompt_instructions: Attach the original image as the primary reference for the full store layout and prop placement.
Keep visible text exactly as 'STORE UPDATE' and 'NEW ARRIVAL'.
Maintain a clean retail-documentation look rather than turning the scene into an editorial campaign.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square retail store update poster for a sportswear new arrival display. Show a bright in-store merchandising setup with left and right freestanding racks, a central black display table, a vertical athlete poster in the back center, a football, a gold trophy, cups, and folded garments. Keep the apparel mix in white, black, and taupe sportswear. Add huge blue text 'STORE UPDATE' across the bottom and a rounded white capsule below it reading 'NEW ARRIVAL'. Technical style: photorealistic retail merchandising poster, bright showroom lighting, clean documentary store atmosphere, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, empty store, incorrect text, low resolution, cluttered layout, distorted racks, warped props, harsh color cast, watermark, signature
